metadata.description: Git-native agentic OS for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot: versioned agents, skills and instructions with hook-enforced governance, MADR decision records, a layered memory stack, a verification-gated self-improvement loop, long-horizon autonomy, an autonomic layer that makes the loop self-triggering, plus commit-integrity guardrails and business/day-job operations.

plugins.name: core-orchestration
plugins.description: Authoring and release discipline for the agentic OS: atomic commits per core change, MADR decision records, skill/agent authoring conventions and SemVer release flow.

plugins.name: governance-gates
plugins.description: Hook-enforced quality gates: secret guard, manifest and SemVer validation, atomic-commit enforcement, ADR gate and a structured audit trail of every tool call.

plugins.name: memory-obsidian
plugins.description: Three-layer memory: Obsidian vault as the human knowledge base, a local SQLite FTS5 + sqlite-vec hybrid retrieval index, and durable session memory captured at session end.

plugins.name: self-evolution
plugins.description: The self-improvement substrate: a capability-eval harness with regression tracking, an experience miner over the audit trail, and a proposal engine that turns recurring patterns into governed capability proposals.

plugins.name: long-horizon
plugins.description: Long-horizon autonomy: durable missions that outlive sessions with structural resumability at session start, an evidence-derived capability self-model, and a learning frontier that orders what the system should learn next.

plugins.name: autonomic-loop
plugins.description: The autonomic nervous system: hook-driven policy that makes the loop self-triggering — core changes are verified before a turn may end (blocking on regression), sessions end by staging mined proposals, and sessions start knowing the system's state. Kill-switchable; capability stays elsewhere.

plugins.name: proto-forge
plugins.description: Brief -> deterministic security-first React 19 + TypeScript + Vite prototype: owned component library, full test suite, WCAG 2.2 AA, i18n, ADRs and a pnpm verify gate suite.

plugins.name: core-guardrails
plugins.description: Production gates: commit-integrity attestation, security, no-placeholder, ship lockstep, telemetry, self-evolution meta-skills (skill-forge, guardrail-forge).

plugins.name: memory-fabric
plugins.description: Two-tier persistent memory: git core + Obsidian vault. Capture, retro, compaction, cross-platform sync.

plugins.name: business-ops
plugins.description: Solopreneur operations: content pipeline, consulting invoicing, JetBrains plugin releases, product launches.

plugins.name: day-job
plugins.description: Enterprise day-job skills: weekly status reports, Copilot rollout ops, meeting notes to actions.

plugins.name: security-gate
plugins.description: On-demand AI security review: contextual, data-flow-aware vulnerability scanning with adversarial validation and human-gated patch proposals. Complements core-guardrails' mechanical gitleaks/semgrep/osv-scanner Stop-hook gate. Ships no hooks.
